title: OmniSpec spec fit answers
description: Declared answers that select the ceremony route. Structural validation does not prove the answers are true; the route is derived from them, never written by hand.

reasoning.description: Whether the problem was reasoned about before drafting. Reasoning, not the specification, is what raises correctness on small changes.

files.description: Files the change touches. Planning overhead only pays back from three files upwards.

modules.description: Separate modules or packages the change touches. Cross-module work is the primary failure surface.

crossesContract.description: Whether a public API, data schema, storage format or other dependency contract changes.

ambiguity.description: Remaining ambiguity in the request. Models cannot detect ambiguity on their own.

existingTests.description: Whether automated tests already cover the area being changed.
